description: This file defines the OAuthServer class, which manages OAuth2 authorization server operations, including initialization of repositories, configuration, and grant types for OAuth2 authentication flows.

classes.name: OAuthServer
classes.description: Class responsible for initializing and managing an OAuth2 authorization server using league/oauth2-server library, including setting up grant types and managing token TTL configurations.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the repositories, encryption keys, and token TTL values from the configuration service.

methods.name: getServer
methods.description: Returns an instance of the configured AuthorizationServer, initializing it if necessary, and sets up grant types for authorization and refresh tokens.

methods.name: getAuthCodeTTL
methods.description: Retrieves the TTL (time-to-live) for the authorization code grant.

methods.name: getRefreshTokenTTL
methods.description: Retrieves the TTL for the refresh token grant.

methods.name: getAccessTokenTTL
methods.description: Retrieves the TTL for access tokens.
